main_text.l: RESP. Primo Propositio est falsa. Quid enim, si fictitiū[?]

l.i: purgatorium in Scriptura non traditur, propterea illa non
continet omnia ad salutem necessaria? Simile est: Si donatio
illa à Constantino Magno facta est Romano Papæ, & tamen ex
Scriptura probari non potest: tum ea non omnia continet.
Secundo etiam assumtionis pars prior, qua asseritur Purga-
torium esse, falsa est: nullibi enim Scriptura docet, esse ejusm-
odi aliquod purgatorium, quale Pontificij fingūt: imo Scriptu-
rae é diametro repugnat. Tertio altera assumtionis pars,
quâ dicitur, purgatorium non posse probari ex Sacris literis, ad-
versatur ipsis Iesuitis. Nam si Purgatorium non potest proba-
ri ex Sacris literis; cur igitur testimonia ex Sacris literis ad
purgatorij defensionem Iesuitae adducunt? Exceptio. At Bel-
larminus ex Lutheri falsitem[?], non ex suo sensu loquitur.

main_text.l: RESP. Cùm Lutheri testimonium alleget, vel assenti-

page.notes: No printed page number: the "324" at top right is a handwritten number and is left out. No running head. The catchword "non" and signature "C 2" are at the foot. Greek "ἐγγραφον" is uncertain in its breathing and accents, so it is marked [?]. "fictitiū", "falsitem" and the sign "⌣" before "At prius" and "Ac si" are uncertain readings; the sign is a printed mark whose meaning is unclear. Line-end hyphens are kept as printed; "potest" and "Iesuitae" run over line ends without a printed hyphen and are written whole.
